sections.title: What changed
items: Ledger works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

sections.title: What's new
items: Nothing changes in the app — this release back-fills the ledger's wiki (vision through next tasks, plus both build prompts) into installed copies that predate doc seeding.

sections.title: What's new
items: Your money, at home — every account in your file via SimpleFIN.
An analyst on tap over your real transactions, and a time machine for your net worth.
Compelling out of the box: sample data until you connect.
